description: This file defines a SwiftUI View called ChatSheet, which acts as a chat interface component. It manages chat session state, handles dismiss actions, and displays a chat UI with a dynamic title based on the agent's name.

classes.name: ChatSheet
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing a chat interface with session management and dismiss capabilities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ChatSheet with session gateway, session key, and optional agent name and user accent color.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the UI layout of the chat sheet, including navigation and chat view.

methods.name: chatTitle
methods.description: Computes the title for the chat interface based on agent name.
